// Portfolio data for Naga Sai Srinivas Matta

export const portfolioData = {
  personal: {
    name: "Naga Sai Srinivas Matta",
    title: "Cybersecurity Professional",
    subtitle: "GRC | Security Operations | Threat Management",
    email: "nagasaisrinivas@careerattainment.com",
    phone: "+1 (656) 209 1709",
    location: "USA",
    linkedin: "https://www.linkedin.com/in/naga-sai-srinivas-matta-b1596928a/",
    github: "https://github.com/NSSMatta",
    bio: "Cybersecurity professional with 4+ years of hands-on experience in threat detection, vulnerability management, incident response, and security architecture across enterprise and cloud environments. Specialized in GRC assessments, SIEM operations, and security tool administration."
  },

  experience: [
    {
      id: 1,
      title: "Compliance Analyst",
      company: "ApiJET",
      location: "USA",
      period: "December 2024 - Present",
      type: "Full-time",
      achievements: [
        "Conducted enterprise GRC assessments across 20+ business systems using ServiceNow GRC, OneTrust, and LogicGate",
        "Performed risk analysis and control mapping aligned with ISO 27001, SOC 2, GDPR, and NIST CSF",
        "Managed 150+ audit artifacts annually, improving audit response efficiency by 30%",
        "Maintained enterprise risk registers tracking 100+ open risks with 95% on-time closure rate",
        "Authored and updated 25+ security policies and SOPs aligned with regulatory mandates",
        "Performed control testing across 40+ controls, collaborating with IT and engineering teams"
      ]
    },
    {
      id: 2,
      title: "Information Security Tools Analyst",
      company: "University of South Florida",
      location: "USA",
      period: "August 2024 - Present",
      type: "Part-time",
      achievements: [
        "Monitored and triaged 1,000+ weekly security events across Splunk, QRadar, Microsoft Sentinel, and ArcSight",
        "Reduced Mean Time to Detect (MTTD) by 25% through enhanced correlation logic",
        "Conducted quarterly vulnerability assessments across 500+ assets using Tenable Nessus, Qualys, and Rapid7",
        "Administered IAM and PAM controls for 2,000+ user accounts using SailPoint, Okta, Azure AD, and CyberArk",
        "Supported 50+ security incident investigations annually with root cause analysis",
        "Managed EDR/XDR platforms across 1,500+ endpoints, reducing false positives by 20%"
      ]
    },
    {
      id: 3,
      title: "Network Security Analyst",
      company: "TCS",
      location: "India",
      period: "September 2021 - July 2023",
      type: "Full-time",
      achievements: [
        "Monitored enterprise network traffic and IDS/IPS alerts across 5,000+ endpoints within SOC operations",
        "Executed monthly vulnerability scans across 800+ systems, reducing critical vulnerabilities by 25%",
        "Configured and maintained Fortinet firewalls, Cisco ASA devices, and 200+ VPN tunnels",
        "Strengthened IAM controls for 4,000+ user accounts using Active Directory and Okta",
        "Supported ISO 27001 and HIPAA compliance audits, documenting 50+ security controls",
        "Responded to 100+ phishing and malware incidents annually using CrowdStrike EDR"
      ]
    }
  ],

  education: [
    {
      id: 1,
      degree: "Master's Degree",
      field: "Information Security",
      institution: "University of South Florida",
      location: "USA",
      period: "August 2023 - May 2025",
      status: "Completed"
    },
    {
      id: 2,
      degree: "Bachelor's Degree",
      field: "Computer Science",
      institution: "JNTUK Kakinada",
      location: "India",
      period: "September 2019 - May 2023",
      status: "Completed"
    }
  ],

  certifications: [
    {
      id: 1,
      name: "AWS Certified Security - Specialty",
      issuer: "Amazon Web Services",
      icon: "award"
    },
    {
      id: 2,
      name: "CompTIA CySA+ ce",
      issuer: "CompTIA",
      icon: "shield-check"
    },
    {
      id: 3,
      name: "CompTIA Cybersecurity Analyst (CySA+)",
      issuer: "CompTIA",
      icon: "shield-check"
    },
    {
      id: 4,
      name: "CompTIA Security Analytics Professional - CSAP",
      issuer: "CompTIA",
      icon: "badge-check"
    },
    {
      id: 5,
      name: "Certified Network Security Practitioner (CNSP)",
      issuer: "The SecOps Group",
      icon: "network"
    }
  ],

  skills: {
    "Governance, Risk & Compliance": [
      "ServiceNow GRC", "RSA Archer", "MetricStream", "OneTrust", "LogicGate",
      "AuditBoard", "Risk Assessments", "Control Mapping", "Regulatory Interpretation",
      "Compliance Monitoring", "Risk Register Management"
    ],
    "Security Operations & SIEM": [
      "Splunk", "IBM QRadar", "Microsoft Sentinel", "ArcSight", "LogRhythm",
      "Incident Triage", "Root Cause Analysis", "Threat Detection Engineering",
      "UEBA", "SOAR", "Log Correlation", "Security Monitoring"
    ],
    "Vulnerability & Threat Management": [
      "Tenable Nessus", "Qualys", "Rapid7 InsightVM", "CVE/CVSS Analysis",
      "Risk Prioritization", "Remediation Tracking", "MITRE ATT&CK",
      "OpenCTI", "MISP", "Threat Intelligence Platforms"
    ],
    "Identity & Access Management": [
      "SailPoint", "Okta", "Azure AD", "CyberArk", "BeyondTrust", "Thycotic",
      "RBAC", "MFA", "Access Reviews", "Privileged Access Governance",
      "User Lifecycle Management", "Secrets Management"
    ],
    "Cloud & Zero Trust Security": [
      "AWS Security Hub", "GuardDuty", "CloudTrail", "Azure Security Center",
      "Prisma Cloud", "Zscaler", "Netskope", "Cloudflare One",
      "Zero Trust Architecture", "Identity-Centric Security", "KMS", "Key Vault"
    ],
    "Endpoint & Network Security": [
      "Microsoft Defender", "CrowdStrike Falcon", "SentinelOne", "Symantec",
      "Palo Alto Networks", "Fortinet", "Cisco ASA", "Cisco ISE",
      "Aruba ClearPass", "NAC (802.1X)", "DLP", "Wireshark"
    ],
    "Application Security & DevSecOps": [
      "Burp Suite", "OWASP ZAP", "Veracode", "Checkmarx", "SonarQube",
      "Secure SDLC", "SAST/DAST", "OAuth2.0", "JWT", "WAF",
      "GitHub", "GitLab", "Jenkins", "Azure DevOps"
    ],
    "Penetration Testing & Red Team": [
      "Kali Linux", "Metasploit", "Web/API Pen Testing",
      "Exploit Validation", "Post-Exploitation Analysis", "OWASP Top 10"
    ],
    "Security Analytics & Automation": [
      "Python", "SQL", "Jupyter Notebook", "Power BI", "Tableau",
      "Advanced Excel", "scikit-learn", "UEBA", "AI-driven Threat Detection"
    ]
  },

  stats: [
    { label: "Years Experience", value: "4+" },
    { label: "Security Events/Week", value: "1000+" },
    { label: "Assets Protected", value: "5000+" },
    { label: "Certifications", value: "5" }
  ]
};
